Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & proposal: VP/CTO handshake + tech deep dive

Hi Samir + Leah,

Thanks again for a productive discovery today — appreciate you walking through the latency/throughput constraints on your payments pipeline and the concerns around cost predictability. Quick recap from our side so we stay aligned: 

- Primary pain: 95th pctl tail latency spikes during batch settlement windows (10–15% of requests).
- Current infra: mixed on-prem/GCP, limited ability to commit GPUs for continuous low-latency inference.
- Success metric for pilot: reduce 95th pctl latency by 30% while keeping per-token cost within a $/request target.

Next best step to unblock pilot: a brief executive alignment (VP Eng / CTO handshake) so we can commit to the correct pilot scope and onboard a technical owner for the deep dive. Proposal: 45–60 minute slot that includes: 10–15 min exec-level objectives alignment, 30–40 min technical deep dive (runtime, KV cache approach, integration checklist).

Our availability windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-10-06, 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-10-07, 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

If you can confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (VP Eng or CTO + technical lead), we will lock the meeting and circulate a short agenda + mutual action plan. I attached our one-pager and a starter MAP for reference.

Attachments: redwood-sales-onepager.pdf (1 page), redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP stub)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
